text: Hi i love the app but i accidentaly uninstalled it form my phone, is there a way to get my routines back ?
author: Lisa Skywalker
developer_reply:
Hi! If you were using the app while logged in, your routines will remain as they were at the last synchronization point.
However, if you used the app without logging in, unfortunately, there’s no way to restore your previous data.
